title: How a Janitor Built $8 Million While a Harvard Executive Went Bankrupt

book_reference.title: The Psychology of Money
book_reference.author: Morgan Housel
book_reference.edition_or_url: Opening introduction; page number varies by edition. Conceptual summary, not reproduction of book pages.

scenes.visual: Book opening; split-screen silhouette of modest worker and luxury mansion; huge $8M versus debt.
scenes.text_en: A janitor left about $8 million. A Harvard-educated executive went bankrupt.
scenes.translation_ar: (عامل بسيط ساب ثروة بحوالي 8 مليون دولار، ومدير متعلم خسر ثروته.)
scenes.source_note: Book opening story; verify facts against the cited edition and independent reporting.

scenes.visual: Two facing book pages; one modest home, one executive office; quick page snap.
scenes.text_en: One had little formal education. The other had an MBA.
scenes.translation_ar: (واحد تعليمه محدود، والتاني معاه ماجستير إدارة أعمال.)
scenes.source_note: Book opening story; verify facts against the cited edition and independent reporting.

scenes.visual: Camera dives into the center fold; gold question mark forms from coins.
scenes.text_en: So why did their financial lives end so differently?
scenes.translation_ar: (إزاي نهايتهم المالية كانت مختلفة بالشكل ده؟)
scenes.source_note: Book opening story; verify facts against the cited edition and independent reporting.

scenes.visual: A humble work jacket, gas pump and shop floor represented as editorial still-life.
scenes.text_en: Meet Ronald Read: a gas-station attendant and department-store janitor.
scenes.translation_ar: (اتعرف على رونالد ريد: اشتغل في محطة بنزين وعامل نظافة في متجر.)
scenes.source_note: Book opening story; verify facts against the cited edition and independent reporting.

scenes.visual: Calendar pages flip; small coins accumulate beside the book.
scenes.text_en: He lived modestly, saved steadily, and invested for decades.
scenes.translation_ar: (عاش ببساطة، وادخر باستمرار، واستثمر لعقود.)
scenes.source_note: Book opening story; verify facts against the cited edition and independent reporting.

scenes.visual: A bold $8,000,000 appears, then separates into family and community gifts.
scenes.text_en: When he died in 2014, his estate was worth about $8 million.
scenes.translation_ar: (لما توفى سنة 2014، ثروته كانت حوالي 8 مليون دولار.)
scenes.source_note: Book opening story; verify facts against the cited edition and independent reporting.

scenes.visual: Two clearly labeled gold streams flow to a hospital ($4.8M) and a library ($1.2M).
scenes.text_en: He left about $6 million to a local hospital and library.
scenes.translation_ar: (وساب حوالي 6 مليون دولار لمستشفى ومكتبة في بلدته.)
scenes.source_note: Reuters reporting (Feb. 4, 2015): $4.8 million to Brattleboro Memorial Hospital and $1.2 million to Brooks Memorial Library.

scenes.visual: The facing page reveals an executive desk and luxury property.
scenes.text_en: Now meet Richard Fuscone, a Harvard-educated finance executive.
scenes.translation_ar: (وده ريتشارد فوسكوني، مدير مالي متخرج من هارفارد.)
scenes.source_note: Book opening story; verify facts against the cited edition and independent reporting.

scenes.visual: Architectural blueprint expands; debt figures stack at page edge.
scenes.text_en: He borrowed heavily to expand an enormous home.
scenes.translation_ar: (استدان بمبالغ كبيرة عشان يوسّع بيت ضخم.)
scenes.source_note: Book opening story; verify facts against the cited edition and independent reporting.

scenes.visual: Market chart drops; house silhouette dims; debt column rises.
scenes.text_en: After the 2008 crisis, debt and illiquid assets overwhelmed him.
scenes.translation_ar: (بعد أزمة 2008، الديون والأصول صعبة البيع ضغطت عليه.)
scenes.source_note: Book opening story; verify facts against the cited edition and independent reporting.

scenes.visual: A foreclosure stamp lands on a property document; no sensational imagery.
scenes.text_en: His home eventually went through foreclosure.
scenes.translation_ar: (وفي النهاية، بيته دخل في إجراءات الحجز.)
scenes.source_note: Book opening story; verify facts against the cited edition and independent reporting.

scenes.visual: The two story pages align; IQ symbols fade away.
scenes.text_en: The contrast is not a test of intelligence.
scenes.translation_ar: (المقارنة مش اختبار ذكاء.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: The words SOFT SKILL are underlined; behavioral choices animate around them.
scenes.text_en: Housel argues that money success is a soft skill.
scenes.translation_ar: (هاوسل بيقول إن النجاح المالي مهارة سلوكية.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: A plan on one page; emotional spending impulses appear on the facing page.
scenes.text_en: Knowing what to do is different from doing it under pressure.
scenes.translation_ar: (إنك تعرف الصح غير إنك تقدر تعمله وقت الضغط.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: Income column rises while spending column rises faster.
scenes.text_en: A high income cannot protect you from uncontrolled spending.
scenes.translation_ar: (الدخل العالي مش هيحميك لو مصاريفك خارجة عن السيطرة.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: Small consistent savings fill a growing jar over calendar turns.
scenes.text_en: And a modest income can still leave room to build wealth.
scenes.translation_ar: (حتى الدخل البسيط ممكن يسيب مساحة لبناء ثروة.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: Luxury-car reflection dissolves into an unseen reserve behind the page.
scenes.text_en: Wealth is not the car people see. It is the money you keep.
scenes.translation_ar: (الثروة مش العربية اللي الناس بتشوفها؛ الثروة هي الفلوس اللي احتفظت بيها.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: A gold line opens between two columns, revealing future paths.
scenes.text_en: The gap between earning and spending creates options.
scenes.translation_ar: (الفرق بين دخلك ومصاريفك هو اللي بيخلق اختياراتك.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: A simple ledger highlights income, essentials and remaining balance.
scenes.text_en: Start with one question: what part of your income stays yours?
scenes.translation_ar: (ابدأ بسؤال واحد: كام من دخلك بيفضل معاك فعلًا؟)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: Small monthly coins repeat steadily; no unrealistic growth claim.
scenes.text_en: Choose a saving habit you can repeat—not one that looks impressive.
scenes.translation_ar: (اختار عادة ادخار تقدر تستمر عليها، مش رقم شكله مبهر.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: Three keywords appear on separate page highlights.
scenes.text_en: The lesson: behavior, patience, and room to breathe matter.
scenes.translation_ar: (الخلاصة: السلوك والصبر ووجود مساحة أمان أهم مما تتخيل.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: The book closes halfway; a modest coin stack remains in focus.
scenes.text_en: You do not need to look rich to build real wealth.
scenes.translation_ar: (مش لازم تبان غني عشان تبني ثروة حقيقية.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: A new page turns to a simple compounding curve, teaser only.
scenes.text_en: Save this lesson. Next: why time can make small investments grow.
scenes.translation_ar: (احفظ الدرس ده. الحلقة الجاية: إزاي الوقت بيكبر الاستثمارات الصغيرة.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.

scenes.visual: Book closes; animated gold arrow points to follow prompt.
scenes.text_en: Follow for Episode 2: the surprising power of compounding.
scenes.translation_ar: (تابعنا للحلقة التانية: القوة المدهشة للفائدة المركبة.)
scenes.source_note: Original explanation of the book's central behavioral lesson; not a direct quotation.
